newsitem.title: USA: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $69 - USDA.
newsitem.headline: Kansas feedlot cattle market very slow at $69 - USDA.

text.p: Trade was very slow, with slaughter steers and heifers steady in very light test, USDA said. Inquiry and demand moderate.
Sales confirmed on 200 slaughter steers and 500 slaughter heifers early Friday. Week to date on 67,700 head confirmed including 17,100 head or about 25% previously contracted or formulated cattle.
Sales FOB feedlot net weights after 4 percent shrink.
Slaughter Steers - Select and Choice 2-3 1200-1250 lbs 69.00.
Slaughter Heifers - Select and Choice 2-3 1125-1100 lbs 69.00.
Confirmed - 700 last week - none last year - 600
